alt: 男子抬高下巴，霸占座位並把鞋踩在椅子上，粗暴指揮志工，對一旁請他停止的人毫不理會。
scene_prompt: 飛揚跋扈 means domineering arrogant lawless behavior, not ordinary confident leadership. Modern community recreation room. An arrogant adult man in neat casual clothes monopolizes the middle of a table, leans back with his SHOES rudely planted on a chair meant for others, lifts his chin and points an imperious finger toward a startled seated volunteer as if ordering them about. His other hand dismissively shoves aside a small neat stack of the volunteer's plain forms, with two sheets sliding askew on the table. A second volunteer standing nearby holds up a calm open palm asking him to stop; he visibly ignores them with contemptuous scowl. He is plainly acting above shared rules and treating people disrespectfully, not being celebrated. Three adults only; exactly two arms per person, hands clearly attached to wrists, plausible limbs and fingers. Keep chairs and feet grounded with coherent support, use simple table perspective. Forms may show subtle illegible pencil texture, no readable characters or numerals. No speech bubbles, stars, crowns, medals, or violence. Warm pencil contours with soft restrained watercolor and visible ivory paper texture. Child-friendly cautionary humor.
